## Checks

- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] No test was edited to make the code pass. If one was, the commit message says what it
      asserted, why that was wrong, and what replaces it.
- [ ] No pathological behaviour is written into the environment (CONTRACT rule 7). Padding,
      hoarding and storming must be available to an agent as choices, never produced by the
      environment itself.
- [ ] No held-out phenomenon is plotted, tested, scored or summarised (storming excess,
      hoarding-to-shortage, blat, hidden reserves).
